front.title: Reporting Crawler Traffic by Verification Level

abstract.t: The User-Agent header is written by the client. It is a claim, not an identity. Reports of crawler and AI crawler traffic that count requests by User-Agent token alone present claims as activity. This document defines four counts a crawler traffic report should give per crawler token: declared, route-consistent, verified, and unverifiable. It states which verification check was possible at the vantage point where the log was taken. It also defines a small JSON report object.
